title: Observational constraints on evolution of dust disc properties in Upper Scorpius
question: How do dust disc sizes, fluxes and structures of Upper Scorpius discs evolve compared with younger regions, and do dust evolution models with mild external photoevaporation reproduce them?

data.bands: Band 7 (0.88 mm), continuum and CO J=3-2

what.value: ALMA Band 7 UpperSco survey data, fluxes and sizes (used for unresolved disc fluxes and comparison)

evidence.quote: for the unresolved discs we use the values from (cite: carpenter2025), as their typical uncertainties are lower.

what.value: Gas disc sizes R_CO for 67 discs plus upper limits

evidence.quote: Zagaria et al. (in prep)  measured gas disc sizes for the 78 discs in the sample of UpperSco where emission from $^{12}$CO $J=3-2$ was detected at $>5\sigma$ level.

what.value: Lupus dust disc radii R90 for comparison

evidence.quote: The Lupus values are calculated from (cite: guerra2025).
the effective temperatures are obtained from spectral types from (cite: manara2020) if available, otherwise from (cite: luhman2022)
We sampled from this probability to compute the distribution of the FUV flux (cite: anania2025b).

recipe.method: Fit axisymmetric Gaussian ring/disc intensity model to visibilities with Galario; point source for unresolved discs
key_parameters: 7 free parameters (f0, sigma_r, R_peak, inc, PA, dRA, dDec); 8 walkers per parameter; 30,000 steps then final 10,000; uniform priors; 256x256 pixels of 0.02 arcsec
assumptions: Structured if R_peak > 0.05 arcsec, smooth otherwise; unresolved size upper limit 0.1 arcsec (14.5 au)

recipe.goal: Disc size distributions and Lupus comparison
recipe.method: Kaplan-Meier CDFs including upper limits, logrank test vs Lupus; K-S test for smooth vs structured
Bayesian linear regression in log space with upper limits
assumptions: Dust mass: optically thin, kappa=2.3 cm2/g (nu/230GHz)^0.4, T=20 K

recipe.method: Teff and L compared with Baraffe 2015 tracks; 10% error on L and Teff

recipe.goal: Gas and dust evolution models with synthetic observables
recipe.method: DustPy simulations with pressure bumps and external photoevaporation; compute 340 GHz flux, R90, R_CO
key_parameters: rc=80 au, gamma=1, Mdisc=0.05 Mstar, alpha0=1e-3, vfrag=10 m/s, 150 radial cells 1-300 au, F_UV 1,10,20,40 G0 switched on at 1 Myr
assumptions: inclination 45 deg, background temperature 20 K, beam 0.1 arcsec, distance 145 pc, detection threshold 3x0.15 mJy/beam

evidence.quote: we find that 24 discs ($\sim$20%) are resolved and structured
The median value of the $R_{\rm{CO}}$/$R_{90}$ ratio for all the resolved discs is $2.7^{+0.3}_{-0.4}$.

not_stated_but_needed: Calibration and imaging details of the visibility data (taken from Carpenter et al. 2025)
Which measurement sets and whether continuum-only averaged visibilities were used
uv binning and Galario setup (priors ranges, initial positions, weighting)
Criterion for choosing point source vs Gaussian fit
linmix settings and handling of upper limits
Exact F_UV values per disc and the disc-star separation procedure

score_reason: Public data and clear fitting recipe, but calibration inherited and some inputs unpublished.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, stated visibility fitting recipe and numeric results (R90 medians, slopes).
